claims.natural_statement: For every smooth connected complex curve and rank r, exact quasi-unipotent boundary classes admit ambient integral density over the one finite extension L specified in introduction.tex, Theorem main.
Every surface diagram with ranks at most r and prescribed scalar puncture monodromies has Zariski-dense integral solutions over R (diagrams.tex, Theorem diagram-density).
Assuming density for all diagrams of rank less than n, density holds for normalized diagrams of rank at most n with nonclosed rank-n facets (reduction.tex, Proposition nonclosed-reduction).

A reduced row-to-column split/interchange/merge gallery admits a common splitting with all identified quotients, and compatible endpoint graded isomorphisms extend through it with free affine matrix parameters.

Compatible filtered exact data lift to U direct-sum Q as the torsor Hom(Q,U)/K with K={h:h(Q_i) subset U_(i-1)}; forgetting a compatible coarse identification gives the separate affine quotient maps stated in filtered-lift.
Every solution of a cut-band diagram with matched two-flag strips sews to the old band using an affine space of full gallery-compatible isomorphisms.

Every lower split/merge gadget supplies the full coarse exact data with internal W flag; its two separate restrictions are affine surjections with difference module direct-sum_(k<j) Hom(q_j,w_k) on the fine side.

Every lower complementary-swap gadget supplies the full exact sequence U_* to A direct-sum B to Q_* and its given decomposition; the incoming and outgoing restrictions have free difference modules Hom(y,a) and Hom(x,b), respectively, with no division by 2.

A finite sequence of vertex lifts with separately surjective incoming restriction closes around the disk because the starting lift, including its quotient identifications, is unique and Hom(Q,U) has trivial puncture monodromy.

For every rank pattern arising from an old complex solution and every admissible solution of the manuscript lower diagram, the punctured disk admits reconstruction preserving every specified quotient identification and closing around the boundary. Reconstruction is a finite tower of locally affine bundles; over every integral lower solution all fibers have finite free integral matrix parameters. Zero blocks, reversed events, repeated facet occurrences, and cyclic lists are included.

The remaining closed-facet density step is supplied by the rank-one/genus-zero cases, torus-density, and closed-density using surface-irreducibility and same-rank nonclosed density; it is outside this reconstruction mission.
The diagram theorem, uniform-field determinant twisting, and exact-stratum quotient selection imply the main theorem; these arithmetic/descent steps are outside this reconstruction mission.
Over R=O_(K(sqrt(2),zeta_pq)), free additive matrix parameters and general linear frame changes have Zariski-dense integral points (arithmetic.tex, integral-parameters and free-splittings).

For all additive commutative groups a,b,h,x,y, the complementary-swap maps have the explicit chain contraction and hence form a split exact sequence. For every finite dependent chain of event maps with surjective incoming maps, every starting state has a compatible path; a subsingleton starting-state type and an endpoint transport force closure. These are algebraic cores only, not a formalization of arbitrary lower-diagram normalization or of the density theorem.

import Mathlib

namespace DiskReconstruction

section Swap

variable {A B H X Y : Type*}
variable [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup H]
variable [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y]

def swapP (u : A × B × H) : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y) :=
  ((u.1, u.2.2, 0), (u.2.1, u.2.2, 0))

def swapI (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) : H × X × Y :=
  (z.1.2.1 - z.2.2.1, z.1.2.2, z.2.2.2)

def swapR (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) : A × B × H :=
  (z.1.1, z.2.1, z.2.2.1)

def swapS (q : H × X × Y) : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y) :=
  ((0, q.1, q.2.1), (0, 0, q.2.2))

theorem swap_ip (u : A × B × H) :
    swapI (swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) u) = 0 := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI, swapP]

theorem swap_rp (u : A × B × H) :
    swapR (swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) u) = u := by
  rfl

theorem swap_is (q : H × X × Y) :
    swapI (swapS (A := A) (B := B) q) = q := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI, swapS]

theorem swap_contraction (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapP (swapR z) + swapS (swapI z) = z := by
  ext <;> simp [swapP, swapR, swapS, swapI] <;> abel

theorem swap_p_add (u v : A × B × H) :
    swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) (u + v) = swapP u + swapP v := by
  ext <;> simp [swapP]

theorem swap_i_add (z t : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapI (z + t) = swapI z + swapI t := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI] <;> abel

theorem swap_p_injective :
    Function.Injective (swapP (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) := by
  intro u v huv
  have hr := congrArg (swapR (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) huv
  simpa only [swap_rp] using hr

theorem swap_i_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (swapI (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) := by
  intro q
  exact ⟨swapS q, swap_is q⟩

theorem swap_exact (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapI z = 0 ↔ ∃ u : A × B × H, swapP u = z := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨swapR z, ?_⟩
    simpa [hz, swapS] using (swap_contraction z)
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact swap_ip u

end Swap

section Closure

universe u v

variable {X : ℕ → Type u} {E : ℕ → Type v}
variable (incoming : (i : ℕ) → E i → X i)
variable (outgoing : (i : ℕ) → E i → X (i + 1))

inductive LiftPath :
    (n : ℕ) → X 0 → X n → Prop
  | nil (x : X 0) : LiftPath 0 x x
  | step {n : ℕ} {start : X 0} {last : X n}
      (path : LiftPath n start last) (e : E n)
      (compatible : incoming n e = last) :
      LiftPath (n + 1) start (outgoing n e)

theorem path_exists (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i, i < n → Function.Surjective (incoming i)) →
    ∀ start : X 0, ∃ last : X n, LiftPath incoming outgoing n start last := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro _ start
      exact ⟨start, LiftPath.nil start⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro surj start
      obtain ⟨last, path⟩ :=
        ih (fun i hi => surj i (Nat.lt_trans hi (Nat.lt_succ_self n))) start
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := surj n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) last
      exact ⟨outgoing n e, LiftPath.step path e he⟩

theorem anchored_closure (n : ℕ)
    (surj : ∀ i, i < n → Function.Surjective (incoming i))
    (start : X 0) (close : X n → X 0) [Subsingleton (X 0)] :
    ∃ last : X n,
      LiftPath incoming outgoing n start last ∧ close last = start := by
  obtain ⟨last, path⟩ := path_exists incoming outgoing n surj start
  exact ⟨last, path, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

end Closure

end DiskReconstruction

import Mathlib

namespace DiskReconstruction

section Swap

variable {A B H X Y : Type*}
variable [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup H]
variable [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y]

def swapP (u : A × B × H) : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y) :=
  ((u.1, u.2.2, 0), (u.2.1, u.2.2, 0))

def swapI (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) : H × X × Y :=
  (z.1.2.1 - z.2.2.1, z.1.2.2, z.2.2.2)

def swapR (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) : A × B × H :=
  (z.1.1, z.2.1, z.2.2.1)

def swapS (q : H × X × Y) : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y) :=
  ((0, q.1, q.2.1), (0, 0, q.2.2))

theorem swap_ip (u : A × B × H) :
    swapI (swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) u) = 0 := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI, swapP]

theorem swap_rp (u : A × B × H) :
    swapR (swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) u) = u := by
  rfl

theorem swap_is (q : H × X × Y) :
    swapI (swapS (A := A) (B := B) q) = q := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI, swapS]

theorem swap_contraction (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapP (swapR z) + swapS (swapI z) = z := by
  ext <;> simp [swapP, swapR, swapS, swapI]

theorem swap_p_add (u v : A × B × H) :
    swapP (X := X) (Y := Y) (u + v) = swapP u + swapP v := by
  ext <;> simp [swapP]

theorem swap_i_add (z t : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapI (z + t) = swapI z + swapI t := by
  ext <;> simp [swapI] <;> abel

theorem swap_p_injective :
    Function.Injective (swapP (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) := by
  intro u v huv
  have hr := congrArg (swapR (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) huv
  simpa only [swap_rp] using hr

theorem swap_i_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (swapI (A := A) (B := B) (H := H) (X := X) (Y := Y)) := by
  intro q
  exact ⟨swapS q, swap_is q⟩

theorem swap_exact (z : (A × H × X) × (B × H × Y)) :
    swapI z = 0 ↔ ∃ u : A × B × H, swapP u = z := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨swapR z, ?_⟩
    have hs : swapS (A := A) (B := B) (0 : H × X × Y) = 0 := rfl
    have hc := swap_contraction z
    rw [hz, hs, add_zero] at hc
    exact hc
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact swap_ip u

end Swap

section Closure

universe u v

variable {X : ℕ → Type u} {E : ℕ → Type v}
variable (incoming : (i : ℕ) → E i → X i)
variable (outgoing : (i : ℕ) → E i → X (i + 1))

inductive LiftPath :
    (n : ℕ) → X 0 → X n → Prop
  | nil (x : X 0) : LiftPath 0 x x
  | step {n : ℕ} {start : X 0} {last : X n}
      (path : LiftPath n start last) (e : E n)
      (compatible : incoming n e = last) :
      LiftPath (n + 1) start (outgoing n e)

theorem path_exists (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i, i < n → Function.Surjective (incoming i)) →
    ∀ start : X 0, ∃ last : X n, LiftPath incoming outgoing n start last := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro _ start
      exact ⟨start, LiftPath.nil start⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro surj start
      obtain ⟨last, path⟩ :=
        ih (fun i hi => surj i (Nat.lt_trans hi (Nat.lt_succ_self n))) start
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := surj n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) last
      exact ⟨outgoing n e, LiftPath.step path e he⟩

theorem anchored_closure (n : ℕ)
    (surj : ∀ i, i < n → Function.Surjective (incoming i))
    (start : X 0) (close : X n → X 0) [Subsingleton (X 0)] :
    ∃ last : X n,
      LiftPath incoming outgoing n start last ∧ close last = start := by
  obtain ⟨last, path⟩ := path_exists incoming outgoing n surj start
  exact ⟨last, path, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

end Closure

end DiskReconstruction

claims.natural_statement: For arbitrary commutative rings and named finite free lower-swap blocks, the actual maps with arbitrary off-diagonal shears and invertible h contact maps satisfying the -I cycle equation admit the explicit invertible normalizations N_A,N_B,N_Q. The middle normalization is block diagonal on the actual A direct-sum B, the a,b,x,y quotient identifications are unchanged, and both injection and projection squares commute. No extra compatibility equation or inverse of 2 is required.
